headerTitle1: Visit the „Gheorghe Asachi” Technical University of Iasi
article1Title: The "Gheorghe Asachi" Technical University Library - the center of knowledge in Iași
article1Text: The Library of the Technical University “Gheorghe Asachi” of Iași, since its establishment in 1948, initially holding a collection of 12,000 volumes, has contributed to supporting the educational and research process by providing information and documentation to its users. Today, it offers access to a collection of approximately 1,000,000 volumes, covering a wide range of specialties in science, technology, economics, and law. The TUIASI Library is constantly evolving, seeking new solutions for the implementation and enhancement of modern information and documentation systems, communication, and the selection and direction of information for users through its seven branch libraries. Currently, the Library of the Technical University “Gheorghe Asachi” of Iași, located in the Reading Room of Building "A" within the University Palace, was voted in 2015 as the most beautiful functional library in the world. It competed with renowned libraries such as Trinity College Library in Dublin, the Royal Portuguese Library in Rio de Janeiro, and the National Library of Prague. The library opens its doors to all those who wish to visit a masterpiece of architecture, recognized as a national heritage site in 1955 and a symbol of academic Iași. We invite you to one of the guided tours organized every day, Monday to Friday, between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM, during which you will "turn the pages" of the history of the University Palace and the Library.
